# FAA Flight Schools

> The largest online directory of FAA-certified flight schools, pilot training programs, and aviation education providers across the United States and Canada.

FAA Flight Schools provides a comprehensive searchable database of flight training schools organized by location and specialization, covering everything from private pilot certification to advanced ratings like type ratings and turbine transition training. The site serves as a central resource for aspiring pilots and aviation professionals seeking certified training programs.

## Key Topics

- Flight School Directory
- Pilot Training
- FAA Certification
- Aviation Education
- Flight Training Schools
- Pilot Certification
- Part 141 Schools
- Type Rating Training
- Multi-Engine Training

- Air Traffic Control

## Flight School Directories

- [FAA Flight Schools Home](https://www.faaflightschools.com): Main homepage for FAA Flight Schools directory across US and Canada
- [Airplane Schools by State](https://www.faaflightschools.com/airplane-schools): Directory of airplane flight schools organized by US state
- [Helicopter Schools by State](https://www.faaflightschools.com/helicopter-schools): Directory of helicopter flight schools and training locations by state
- [Aircraft Mechanic Schools](https://www.faaflightschools.com/aircraft-mechanic-schools): Directory of aircraft mechanic training schools across the US
- [Air Traffic Control Schools](https://www.faaflightschools.com/air-traffic-control-schools): Directory of FAA air traffic control training schools and programs

## Specialized Pilot Training

- [Type Rating Schools](https://www.faaflightschools.com/type-rating): Directory of type rating schools for aircraft certification by location
- [Multi-Engine Training Schools](https://www.faaflightschools.com/multi-engine-training): Directory of multi-engine twin aircraft training schools and programs
- [Turbine Transition Schools](https://www.faaflightschools.com/turbine-transition): Directory of turbine transition training schools for airline pilot preparation
- [Multi-Engine Time Building](https://www.faaflightschools.com/multi-time-building): Directory of multi-engine time building schools organized by state
- [Seaplane Training Schools](https://www.faaflightschools.com/seaplane-training): Directory of seaplane training schools and ratings by state location
- [Tailwheel Training Schools](https://www.faaflightschools.com/tail-wheel): Directory of tailwheel training schools organized by state location
- [Aerobatic Training Schools](https://www.faaflightschools.com/aerobatic-training): Directory of aerobatic training schools and specialized flight instruction

## Aviation Training & Certification

- [Aircraft Dispatcher Schools](https://www.faaflightschools.com/aircraft-dispatcher): Directory of aircraft dispatcher training schools and certification programs
- [Sport Pilot Certification](https://www.faaflightschools.com/sport-pilot): Sport pilot license requirements, information and FAQ for certification
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.faaflightschools.com/knowledge_base.php): Knowledge base covering FAA regulations, pilot training types and certification

## Aviation Experiences & Services

- [Skydiving Schools](https://www.faaflightschools.com/skydiving-school): Directory of skydiving schools and lessons across the United States
- [Air Tours](https://www.faaflightschools.com/air-tours): Directory of scenic airplane and helicopter tour operators in US

## Optional Resources

- [Flight School Schedule](https://www.faaflightschools.com/whats-new/flight-school-schedule.php): Free online flight scheduling tool for flight schools and instructors
